Hello,

I saw the UI/UX Designer opening at ProWiz Analytics and wanted to share my background designing data-informed products.

At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated user feedback directly into improved interface flows, handling design-to-development handoffs with developers.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I built a cleaner verification experience for teams depending on accurate email lists: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Could we spend fifteen minutes this week discussing how my Figma workflow and computer science background can support your product team?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
